human_truth: The safest kind of home is where both people can be ridiculous, and the story still makes sense beat by beat.
emotional_arc: shared search setup -> phone planted in pocket -> phone reveal -> remote planted under him -> remote reveal -> sofa still blamed -> no-judgement home thesis
source_story_summary: At home, a couple becomes a tiny search party. She is looking for her phone while it is already in her hand. He is looking for the remote while it is already in his hand. They still check the sofa cushions together. The story is not about forgetfulness as advice; it is about the no-judgement comedy of home, where both people can be ridiculous and no one has to act smart.
